_doc: Machine hosting the failing job. The robot version (23.4.0) is checked to rule out a known robot-build defect; it is NOT the cause of this fault. The 0xE0434352 exit code is produced by the unhandled managed exception itself — recover it from job traces, not by upgrading the robot.
